articles.headline: Manuel Pellegrini bemoans 'inexplicable decisions' as Real Betis lose to Barcelona
articles.description: Real Betis coach Manuel Pellegrini blamed "incomprehensible and inexplicable decisions" for his side's 5-2 loss at home to Barcelona on Saturday in LaLiga.
articles.headlineJa: マヌエル・ペジェグリン監督、レアル・ベティスがバルセロナに敗れ「不可解な判定」に嘆く
articles.descriptionJa: ラ・リーガの土曜日の試合で、レアル・ベティスのマヌエル・ペジェグリン監督は、ホームでバルセロナに2-5で敗れた原因について、「理解不能で不可解な判定」があったと主張した。
articles.body:
Real Betis coach Manuel Pellegrini blamed "incomprehensible and inexplicable decisions" for his side's 5-2 loss at home to Barcelona on Saturday in LaLiga.

Pellegrini bemoaned the call which led to a stunning Giovani Lo Celso strike being ruled out, claimed Barça's third goal should have been disallowed for a foul by Fermín López and lamented the red card shown to Facundo Bernal.

Abde Ezzalzouli had just made it 3-2 when Bernal was sent off, which subsequently ended Betis' hopes of mounting a comeback as they tasted defeat at home for the first time this season. "A feeling of helplessness," Pellegrini told DAZN when asked for his thoughts after the loss at La Cartuja.

"The scoreline does not reflect what the game was like. There were a series of incomprehensible and inexplicable decisions. We were reduced to 10 men and had a goal disallowed ... It was absurd.

"The handball [by Cucho Hernández before Lo Celso scored] had absolutely no bearing on the goal. For their third goal, there was a foot at head height and the VAR didn't review it.

"And as for the sending off, [Bernal] was provoked by Lamine Yamal. Instead of calling both players to account ... We were always the ones who suffered.

"To me, it was a lamentable refereeing [performance]. There is no need to apply the criteria that was applied in all those incidents."

Lo Celso's brilliant shot from distance looked to have made it 2-2 just before half-time after Yamal and Rodri had scored for Barça either side of a Valentín Gómez equaliser.

However, following a lengthy VAR review, the goal was ruled out for a handball by Hernández.

"[Hernández] controlled the ball with his chest and was pushed by the Barcelona defender [knocking the ball towards his hand]," Pellegrini added.

"It was 30 metres out and it had no bearing on the goal. It was the result of the Barcelona player's push. Unfortunately, they've ruined the spectacle in front of 60,000 people."

Pellegrini also felt a high foot from López should have been penalised before Barça's third goal, scored by Gabriel Jesus, but was especially angered by Bernal's dismissal after Abde netted.

"It's a real shame," he continued. "It was close until the incidents happened, which threw the match off balance, especially the sending off."

With Betis a player light, Barça added goals through Eric García and Dani Olmo to run out convincing winners, extending their winning start to the league campaign to a record-equalling nine games.

- Tyler, The Creator to be the next star on Barcelona's shirt

- Brazil winger Antony's home burgled during Real Betis Champions League match

"It was a very evenly matched game," Pellegrini said. "We had our chances. With us down to 10, they scored more goals and took control.

"But right up until the sending off, it was very even against a great team -- undoubtedly the best side in the league."

articles.headline: Sources: Eagles star QB Jalen Hurts on IR due to blood clot, out indefinitely
articles.description: The Eagles have decided to place Jalen Hurts on injured reserve after consultations with numerous doctors and experts, sources told ESPN and NFL Network.
articles.headlineJa: 【情報】イーグルスのスターQBジェイレン・ハーツ、血栓により負傷者リスト(IR)入り、復帰は未定
articles.descriptionJa: ESPNおよびNFLネットワークが得た情報によると、イーグルスは多くの医師や専門家と協議した結果、ジェイレン・ハーツを負傷者リスト(IR)に入れることを決定した。
articles.body:
The Philadelphia Eagles have decided to place Jalen Hurts on injured reserve after consultations with numerous doctors and experts that continued into Saturday, sources told ESPN and NFL Network.

The move will sideline the star quarterback indefinitely, according to sources. The Eagles were waiting to make a roster decision until after consulting with medical experts, according to sources.

Ever since Hurts started dealing with the superficial blood clot in his calf, the Eagles have been attempting to explore every option and gather as much information as possible. Hurts has met with doctors and had others review his blood clot and weigh in with their knowledge.

At some time over the last 24 hours, additional information surfaced that made Philadelphia believe the wisest course of action was to place Hurts on IR, giving him the time he needs to heal.

The Eagles maintained all along that they weren't going to rush into any decisions about Hurts' future, which is why they waited until Thursday to rule out the three-time Pro Bowler for Sunday's home game against the Carolina Panthers.

Hurts now will miss games against the Panthers, Dallas Cowboys, Washington Commanders and New York Giants before the Eagles have their bye in Week 10 with a chance to fully evaluate their quarterback's health and their team's outlook.

Philadelphia believes the blood clot is treatable, and the ultimate decision about when Hurts returns to play will come from his medical team, with the Eagles ready to follow his lead.

In most cases, blood clots are treated with anticoagulants, otherwise known as blood thinners. A player cannot play while on blood thinners.

In general, the minimum time frame for a moderate dose of anticoagulants is six weeks, sources said. There is a possibility, if the clot is minor enough, that doctors begin with anti-inflammatories only, while continuing to monitor. If the clot were to move, as the team said happened in Hurts' case, blood thinners are often the answer. If the clot were to worsen, blood thinners for roughly three months would be the next course of action.

Some doctors around the NFL who have not examined Hurts believe the blood clot could sideline him several weeks. One team's doctor texted ESPN: "It is a broad range and nuance based on size and location and hematology evaluation, but could be six weeks." Another team's doctor had a similar estimation.

The Eagles released a lengthy statement Thursday detailing the process that led to the discovery of the blood clot and to Hurts being ruled out for Sunday's home game against the Panthers.

While Hurts has been receiving treatment, the Eagles have been working to fortify their roster. Backup quarterback Tanner McKee will start against the Panthers, and rookie Cole Payton was promoted to backup. Philadelphia also signed quarterback Joe Milton off Dallas' practice squad. By NFL rules, Milton must be on the Eagles' roster for three weeks.

articles.headline: Steelers place Wilson on IR with finger injury
articles.description: The Pittsburgh Steelers placed Roman Wilson on the injured reserve list, their second key receiver lost to injury in as many weeks.
articles.headlineJa: スティーラーズ、指の負傷でウィルソンを負傷者リスト(IR)へ
articles.descriptionJa: ピッツバーグ・スティーラーズは、ローマン・ウィルソンを負傷者リスト(IR)に入れた。これで、ここ2週間で主要なレシーバーを2人失うことになった。
articles.body:
TAMPA, Fla. -- The Pittsburgh Steelers placed Roman Wilson on the injured reserve list, their second key receiver lost to injury in as many weeks.

Wilson will miss at least four weeks because of a finger injury sustained in Pittsburgh's Week 5 win against the Indianapolis Colts. A favorite downfield target of quarterback Aaron Rodgers, Wilson had two touchdown catches this season.

Last week, the Steelers placed Michael Pittman Jr. on IR after the veteran aggravated a foot injury.

"Seems like at this point it's just in-house options," Rodgers said this week in preparation for Sunday's game against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. "So we've got a talented p-squad group of guys -- and guys who played football at the highest level and made plays. I'm excited about getting those guys in.

"... We'll get some guys who haven't seen a lot of time out there and expect them to play well."

To replace their missing pass catchers, the Steelers elevated receivers Brandon Smith and Brandon Johnson from the practice squad.

The Steelers previously ruled out receiver and special teams ace Ben Skowronek, leaving them without three of their top five pass catchers against Tampa Bay. Meanwhile, tight end Pat Freiermuth (calf) was added to the injury report Saturday and listed as questionable.

The Steelers, however, got good news about top wideout DK Metcalf. He was taken off the injury list after missing Friday's practice with an illness.

"I've always been a fan of Brandon Johnson," Rodgers said this week. "I mean, he had his locker right next to mine last year. We had some great conversations. He's played and played well when he's gotten opportunities. Obviously I know B. Smith from New York and am a big believer in him."

articles.headline: 'Best in the world' Yamal propels Barcelona to record-equaling LaLiga start
articles.description: Barcelona coach Hansi Flick hailed Lamine Yamal as the best player in the world after his side thrashed Real Betis 5-2 to equal the best ever start to a LaLiga season.
articles.headlineJa: 「世界最高」ヤマルがバルセロナを牽引、ラ・リーガ開幕戦の記録に並ぶ好スタート
articles.descriptionJa: バルセロナのハンジ・フリック監督は、レアル・ベティスに5-2で大勝し、ラ・リーガ史上最高の開幕成績に並んだ後、ラミン・ヤマルを「世界最高の選手」と称賛した。
articles.body:
Barcelona coach Hansi Flick hailed Lamine Yamal as the best player in the world after his side thrashed Real Betis 5-2 to equal the best ever start to a LaLiga season.

Yamal, 19, opened the scoring in Seville with a stunning solo goal as Barça notched a ninth straight win to match Real Madrid's record, set in 1961-62 and 1968-69.

- Mourinho praises Vini's Madrid grit: If I were him, I'd have left

- Tyler, The Creator joins list of music stars to appear on Barcelona's Clásico kit

The Spain international has now scored nine goals and assisted another nine in 11 appearances this season in all competitions.

"It was an intense match," Flick said in the postgame news conference. "It was an amazing match, for the fans, all the people who love football, it was amazing.

"Lamine today also, when you see the first goal ... unbelievable. This is for me, at the moment, the best player in the world. I am very happy about his performance.

"Of course he has a lot of pressure. He is only 19, but he's 100% focused, committed with everything. His performance and attitude were amazing. This is how big, big players are."

Yamal's strike in the 10th minute set the tone for a wild encounter. Valentín Gómez drew the home side level before the half-hour mark, only for Rodri, with his first goal for Barça, to restore the Blaugrana's lead in the 41st minute.

A Giovani Lo Celso goal was then ruled out due to a handball in the build-up by Cucho Hernández before Gabriel Jesus made it 3-1 to Barça early in the second half.

Abde Ezzalzouli responded almost immediately to bring Betis back into the game again, but in the aftermath of the celebrations, Facundo Bernal was sent off for head-butting Yamal.

Barça took full advantage of having an additional player for the final half an hour, with Eric García and Dani Olmo completing the rout.

Flick's side have now won all nine of their LaLiga games, scoring 39 goals -- 20 more than any other team in the division -- and will set a new record for the best start to a campaign if they beat Madrid in next Sunday's Clásico.

"This is nice, but we want to win titles," the German coach added of Barça's record-equaling start. "We want to achieve bigger things. This is why we are playing football.

"We are fighting for this, not for records. They are nice to have, but it's all about this. The mentality, how we play together, it's fantastic, and also work together, against the ball, without the ball, it's amazing."

Including the Champions League, Barça have now won 11 games in a row this season, but their winning streak will be tested in two grueling encounters over the next week.

They travel to European champions Paris Saint-Germain on Tuesday and then host Madrid at Spotify Camp Nou in the league next weekend.

Raphinha should be available for both of those fixtures after returning from a hamstring injury to feature off the bench for 20 minutes against Betis.

articles.headline: Bears CB Kyler Gordon set for 2026 debut after PUP activation
articles.description: Bears nickel corner Kyler Gordon has been activated off the PUP list and could make his season debut against the Falcons.
articles.headlineJa: ベアーズのCBカイラー・ゴードン、PUPリストから復帰し2026年デビューへ
articles.descriptionJa: ベアーズのニッケルコーナー、カイラー・ゴードンがPUPリストから復帰し、ファルコンズ戦で今季初出場を果たす可能性がある。
articles.body:
ATLANTA -- Chicago Bears nickel corner Kyler Gordon has been activated off the physically unable to perform list and onto the 53-man roster, the team announced Saturday.

Gordon spent the offseason rehabbing a calf injury that landed him on the PUP list at the start of training camp. He was moved to reserve/PUP on Aug. 30 and had to sit out the Bears' first four games.

He returned to practice Sept. 30 and has been a full participant in every session over the past three weeks.

"He's done a great job taking everything that we've assigned him so far," coach Ben Johnson said Friday. "I feel good about him -- whether that's this week or next week -- I do feel good about him being able to contribute to this team and help us out, and there's a number of ways he can do that. But I'm encouraged with what I've seen so far."

In a corresponding move, the Bears placed defensive end Dayo Odeyingbo on injured reserve. Odeyingbo had already been ruled out for Week 6 with a quad injury sustained against the Green Bay Packers last week. Coach Ben Johnson said this week that Odeyingbo was expected to miss "some time" but that the Bears did not believe his injury was serious enough to warrant IR.

The Bears also released Xavier Woods, who started the last two games at safety, and signed defensive back Nick McCloud from the practice squad to the active roster.

Gordon was drafted 39th overall in 2022, the very first pick by Bears general manager Ryan Poles. Since then, the cornerback has totaled five interceptions, 17 passes defensed, 2.5 sacks, 10 tackles for loss and two forced fumbles.

Injuries were present during his first three seasons (2022-24) but did not stop the Bears from making him the NFL's highest-paid primary slot corner in April 2025 when he signed a three-year, $40 million extension with $31.25 million guaranteed.

Since signing his new deal, Gordon has struggled to stay on the field. He was limited to five games, including the playoffs, in 2025 due to multiple soft tissue injuries and spent two separate stints on injured reserve.

Last season, Gordon allowed 16 receptions on 24 targets for 243 yards and three touchdowns, according to Next Gen Stats. He allowed a passer rating of 139.4 in coverage, which was the third highest in the NFL among cornerbacks (minimum 20 targets), with only Trevon Diggs (154.6) and McCloud (142.2) allowing a higher passer rating.

After being sidelined for the Bears' offseason program and training camp, Gordon spent several weeks away from the team in September rehabbing on his own. He returned to Halas Hall ahead of Week 4 and made an impression on his coaches for how quickly he got up to speed on the practice field and in meetings.

"The one thing about Kyler, he's a sharp kid, or young man, I should say," Bears nickels coach Cannon Matthews said. "So that part I'm not worried about. Even just him being back in meetings, the questions that he asks has always been great that way. So honestly, there's still area for gr

articles.headline: Taylor Moton among 3 Panthers activated ahead of Eagles game
articles.description: The Panthers will have RT Taylor Moton and DE Tershawn Wharton available Sunday against the Eagles. RB Trevor Etienne was also activated off IR.
articles.headlineJa: パンサーズ、イーグルス戦を前にテイラー・モトンら3名をアクティブ化
articles.descriptionJa: パンサーズは日曜日のイーグルス戦に、RTテイラー・モトンとDEターショーン・ウォートンを起用できる。また、RBトレバー・エティエンヌも負傷者リスト(IR)から復帰した。
articles.body:
PHILADELPHIA -- The Carolina Panthers will have right tackle Taylor Moton (lung, blood clot) and defensive end Tershawn Wharton (neck) available for Sunday's game against the Philadelphia Eagles at Lincoln Financial Field.

The Panthers announced Saturday that Moton and Wharton had been activated from the non-football injury/illness and physically unable to perform lists, respectively. Running back Trevor Etienne (ankle) was also activated off injured reserve.

Carolina had three openings on its 53-man roster, so activating Moton, Wharton and Etienne was possible without corresponding moves. Moton and Wharton missed all of training camp and the preseason -- along with the first four games of the regular season -- with their ailments.

Moton had been listed as questionable to play after being a full participant in practice throughout the week. First-round pick Monroe Freeling has started in place of Moton throughout the first four games of his rookie season and offered mixed results. But Freeling sustained a knee injury in the Week 4 win over the Detroit Lions and was given a doubtful tag entering the weekend. Moton, now active, is likely to start at right tackle against the Eagles.

Wharton has been working his way back to the field since undergoing neck surgery in May. The veteran defensive lineman, who signed a three-year, $45 million deal last offseason, has been hindered by various injuries since arriving in Carolina in 2025. He has played just nine games for the franchise, producing 36 total tackles and two sacks.

Wharton, like Moton, was a full participant in practice and was listed as questionable on the final injury report. If active Sunday, he is likely to rotate with the likes of Bobby Brown III, second-round pick Lee Hunter and undrafted rookie Aaron Hall, opposite fellow starter Derrick Brown.

Etienne's return from injured reserve was signaled by coach Dave Canales last week. The coach confirmed that stance Friday. Etienne injured his ankle during the preseason finale against the Houston Texans in August and was subsequently placed on injured reserve ahead of the league's cut-down deadline. He was a full participant in workouts this week, and Canales said he was confident Etienne would play against Philadelphia following the final practice of Week 6.

With fellow running back AJ Dillon (ankle) ruled out for Sunday, Etienne, a 2025 fourth-round pick, could bring stability to the running back depth chart and the return game on special teams. Last season, Etienne had an up-and-down performance as the team's primary kick and punt returner, but Canales has said multiple times this season, even with Etienne on IR, that the former Georgia running back would be the primary option at both jobs upon his return.

articles.headline: Yamal helps Barcelona match best ever LaLiga start ahead of El Clásico
articles.description: Barcelona equalled the best start to a LaLiga season in history by claiming a ninth successive win in a fiery 5-2 win over 10-man Real Betis.
articles.headlineJa: ヤマルが牽引し、バルセロナがエル・クラシコを前にラ・リーガ史上最高のスタートに並ぶ
articles.descriptionJa: バルセロナは、10人となったレアル・ベティスに5-2で快勝し、9連勝を飾ったことで、ラ・リーガ史上最高のシーズン開幕成績に並んだ。
articles.body:
Barcelona equalled the best start to a LaLiga season in history by claiming a ninth successive win in a fiery 5-2 win over 10-man Real Betis.

Lamine Yamal inspired the victory, which saw Hansi Flick's side match a record set by Real Madrid back in the 1968-69 season.

Yamal scored a brilliant opener and set up Gabriel Jesus for the third, with Rodri netting his first for Barça and Eric García and Dani Olmo also on target.

Betis went into the match in third place and scored through Valentín Gómez and Abde Ezzalzouli but, moments after the latter had pulled it back to 3-2, Facundo Bernal was shown a red card for tangling with Yamal.

The result was the ideal way to kick off a big week for Barça, who play Paris Saint-Germain in the Champions League before taking on Madrid in the league next weekend.

Yamal needed less than 10 minutes to make his mark, producing a brilliant turn on the edge of the area and an even better finish, curling a 20-yard shot into the top corner.

Barça dominated possession but Betis drew level in the 27th minute when the visitors failed to clear a corner and Gómez powerfully headed in Pablo Fornals' cross.

Yamal played in Karim Adeyemi, who was denied by a strong hand from Álvaro Valles, while Héctor Bellerín saw his shot well saved by Joan García at the other end.

Barça went back in front four minutes before the break from a corner, with Rodri capitalising on hesitation from Valles, but Betis were furious to see an apparent equaliser ruled out only two minutes later.

Giovani Lo Celso brilliantly found the top corner with a left-foot volley on the spin from outside the box but it was disallowed for a handball in the build-up.

Chances continued to flow after the break and, moments after Jesus saw a first-time finish from a Yamal cross ruled out for a marginal offside, the same two players combined for a goal that did count.

Only a minute later Ezzalzouli sprang the offside trap to reduce the arrears but a melee in the aftermath ended with Bernal being shown a red card for moving his head towards Yamal, who fell to the ground.

The young Spain star was booked for his role in the confrontation but it was a costly blow for Betis and Barça restored their two-goal advantage in the 62nd minute when Pau Cubarsí beat the flailing Valles to a cross and substitute Garcia tapped in.

Anthony Gordon, also on as a replacement, came close to extending the lead before Olmo did add a fifth in the 81st minute.

articles.headline: Premier League recap: Villa defeat Newcastle, Haaland with brace in Man City win
articles.description: Aston Villa were able to get a crucial away win against Newcastle, while there were more goals for Erling Haaland as Manchester City defeated Ipswich Town.
articles.body:
We are back with more European soccer this weekend!

We kicked things off at the Hill-Dickinson Stadium as Chelsea put in a solid performance and earned a 2-0 win over Everton.

Later, Brentford hosted Liverpool, as the Reds looked to build on their midweek UEFA Champions League win against LASK and Andoni Iraola's side did that with a 2-1 comeback win.

Meanwhile, Manchester City looked to bounce back from their Champions League defeat to Paris Saint-Germain when they host Ipswich Town and did so as they won 3-2 with a Erling Haaland brace.

We wrapped up the Premier League slate with Newcastle United taking on Aston Villa, as Unai Emery's team won 1-0 on Tyneside.

Elsewhere across the continent, Bologna welcomed Inter Milan in Serie A where the defending champions won 3-1, while Real Betis face unbeaten Barcelona in LaLiga, as Hansi Flick's side continued their perfect run winning 5-2.

Over in the Bundesliga, Union Berlin took on contenders Borussia Dortmund as the match ended in a scoreless draw, while defending champions Bayern Munich host RB Leipzig and made easy work as they won 6-1.

Enjoy that happened from Saturday's matches.

articles.headline: Harry Kane breaks another record in 100th Bundesliga appearance for Bayern Munich
articles.description: Harry Kane scored his 102nd goal in his 100th Bundesliga game on Saturday, the most by any player in the league's history after a century of appearances.
articles.body:
Harry Kane scored his 102nd goal in his 100th Bundesliga game on Saturday, the most by any player in the league's history after a century of appearances.

During Bayern Munich's 6-1 victory over RB Leipzig, Kane tapped home from Nathaniel Brown's cutback in the 53rd minute to make it 5-0 and mark the milestone with a goal.

In doing so, Kane ensured he smashed the existing record of 72 after 100 appearances -- set by Timo Konietzka for Borussia Dortmund in the 1960s -- by a whopping 30 goals.

It was Kane's fourth goal in six Bundesliga games so far this season, with the England captain having also bagged three in two in the Champions League, as well as a brace in the German Cup win over VfL Osnabruck.

Saturday's achievement is the latest in a long line of records that Kane has broken since arriving from Spurs in 2023.

In September, during a 4-0 victory over Union Berlin, he became the fastest player to reach 100 goals, in his 98th appearance for Bayern.

In total across all competitions, he has scored 155 goals in 157 games for the German club, winning two Bundesliga titles as well as the 2026 German Cup.

The 33-year-old is close to signing a new deal at the club which would keep him there until 2029, sources told ESPN on Friday. His current deal is due to expire at the end of this season.

- Harry Kane has talent for NFL - Jags kicker Cam Little

- Harry Kane close to new Bayern Munich contract - sources

- Transfer rumors, news: Liverpool's Wirtz to Bayern Munich?

Kane is the favourite to win the Ballon d'Or for the first time, with the ceremony set to take place on Oct. 26.

Should he play against Croatia in England's Nations League game on Nov. 12, Kane will also become his nation's most-capped player of all time, with 126 appearances, surpassing the record set by Peter Shilton in 1990.

He is already England's top scorer, with 91 goals.

Information from ESPN Global Research contributed to this report.

articles.headline: Fantasy football Week 6 inactives: Hurts, Jackson ruled out; Flowers to play
articles.description: Updated inactives and analysis based on the latest reports and official announcements leading up to kickoff.
articles.headlineJa: ファンタジー・フットボール第6週の欠場選手情報：ハーツとジャクソンは欠場、フラワーズは出場へ
articles.descriptionJa: キックオフ前の最新レポートと公式発表に基づく、最新の欠場選手情報と分析。
articles.body:
Whom should you start? Whom should you sit? To help you set your fantasy football lineups and avoid starting an offensive player who won't be in the lineup, we'll post fantasy-relevant updates and analysis here as NFL teams release their official inactives lists. 

Official Sunday inactives should begin coming in approximately 90 minutes before the scheduled kickoff times: around 11:30 a.m. ET for the early games and 2:30 p.m. ET for the late-afternoon games.

Refresh often for the latest information.

Don't forget to check these out: Mike Clay's Playbook | Week 6 Buzz 

Week 6 Rankings | Matchup rankings for Week 6

Biggest concerns ahead of Sunday

Players with early starts

Michael Penix Jr, QB, Falcons (ribs): Penix has been a full participant at practice all week long. He has been removed from the injury report and will start Sunday. Penix has yet to throw multiple TD passes or score 15 fantasy points in any game this season. He is purely for use in superflex formats, but his availability is great for Bijan Robinson and Drake London. Both are elite options with Penix under center.

Zay Flowers, WR, Ravens (toe): Flowers was added to the team's injury report Thursday but is not on the final report, meaning he will play in Week 6. His production took a hit without Jackson last week, but Flowers still saw nine targets in that game from QB Tyler Huntley, who will be under center again this week. Volume should keep him in play as a WR2. It's also worth noting that Rashod Bateman missed practice this week due to a shoulder injury but is also not on the final injury report, so he will play too. Rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane is practicing in full and Jeremy Fowler reports he is "good to go" for Week 6. He is worth stashing if you have a bench spot available.

Caleb Williams, QB, Bears (hamstring): Williams has been a full participant at practice and is questionable in Week 6. He might opt to run less initially, but Williams is still in play as a QB1. I would use him over Trevor Lawrence, Jameis Winston and Jacoby Brissett. However, I would go with either Kirk Cousins or Jordan Love over Williams.

Quinshon Judkins, RB, Browns (ankle): Judkins missed practice to start the week before getting in a limited session Friday. He is questionable and his status truly seems to be up in the air for Week 6. If he sits, the Browns will be left with Jaleel McLaughlin and Audric Estime on the active roster. McLaughlin is the preferred play and, while the floor is low, he'd be in the flex conversation due to volume. It's also worth noting that Dylan Sampson had his 21-day window for return opened this week, but he is out for Week 6.

KC Concepcion, WR, Browns (concussion): Concepcion has cleared the league's concussion protocol and will play in Week 6. Though we have seen flashes, Concepcion is more of an upside depth stash for now. Fantasy managers should instead go with some of the other streaming WR options listed in this article.

articles.headline: Commanders RB Jacory Croskey-Merritt out vs. 49ers with groin injury
articles.description: Commanders running back Jacory Croskey-Merritt won't play against the 49ers because of a groin injury, coach Dan Quinn said.
articles.headlineJa: コマンダーズのRBジャコリー・クロスキー＝メリット、鼠径部の負傷により49ers戦を欠場
articles.descriptionJa: ダン・クイン監督によると、コマンダーズのランニングバック、ジャコリー・クロスキー＝メリットは鼠径部の負傷により49ers戦には出場しない。
articles.body:
ASHBURN, Va., -- Washington Commanders running back Jacory Croskey-Merritt won't play Monday against the San Francisco 49ers because of a groin injury, coach Dan Quinn said Saturday.

Croskey-Merritt did not practice all week because of the injury, which he had been dealing with entering Sunday's 27-27 tie against the visiting New York Giants in Week 5. He managed 11 carries for 82 yards but had just one carry after the third quarter.

He missed the final two preseason games because of a groin injury. Quinn called the latest setback a reinjury.

Croskey-Merritt leads Washington with 239 rushing yards and two touchdowns.

Without him, the Commanders will rely on Rachaad White and Austin Ekeler. White has been dealing with a shoulder issue that caused him to be limited Friday after being a full participant a day earlier. Ekeler, who signed before Week 4, has been limited in practice with a chest issue.

Jeremy McNichols will travel with the team to San Francisco and could be activated off injured reserve ahead of Monday's game. McNichols started the season on IR because of a quad injury suffered this summer.

Quinn did not say if wide receiver Stefon Diggs would play after he missed the Giants game with a hamstring injury. Diggs was limited in practice Friday. If he plays, it would be the first time, Diggs, wide receiver Terry McLaurin and quarterback Jayden Daniels have been on the field together since Week 2.

It's also possible the Commanders will return cornerback Trey Amos and safety Nick Cross. Amos has been on injured reserve because of an ankle injury, but he and Cross, who hasn't played since Week 2 with an internal injury, were full participants in practice.

articles.headline: 76ers, needing frontcourt help, convert 7-foot-6 Tacko Fall to two-way contract
articles.description: The 76ers, dealing with injuries in the frontcourt, have converted center Tacko Fall to a two-way contract.
articles.body:
PHILADELPHIA -- The 76ers have converted center Tacko Fall to a two-way contract, the team announced Saturday.

Last month, the Sixers signed the 7-foot-6 center to an Exhibit 10 deal, and injuries to the frontcourt likely led to Fall getting this spot.

Ariel Hukporti, projected to be the Sixers' backup center, suffered a season-ending right Achilles tear in the preseason. Center Adem Bona, potentially the next man up, has been sidelined with a foot injury, and Dominick Barlow has battled back soreness that kept him out of the preseason.

Fall hasn't played in the NBA since the 2021-22 season, when he was with the Cleveland Cavaliers. This will be his fourth season in the NBA. He played his first two in Boston with new Sixers forward Jaylen Brown.

Fall, 30, most recently played for the Ningbo Rockets of the Chinese Basketball Association.

articles.headline: James, Embiid play 76ers' preseason finale, 'still working on our rhythm'
articles.description: Without VJ Edgecombe, who was held out of Friday night's 125-120 loss to the Celtics, 76ers coach Nick Nurse gave the closest glimpse of what his team may look like this season, including LeBron James and Joel Embiid playing preseason highs in minutes.
articles.body:
PHILADELPHIA -- As the 76ers begin a season with a star-laden roster, center Joel Embiid rejects the narrative that anyone needs to sacrifice for this team to succeed.

"I'm against the concept of sacrificing," Embiid said after Friday's preseason finale. "I think the way I explained it was you do what you do best, and we're going to support you. ... I don't think anybody has to take a back seat."

Albeit without second-year starting guard VJ Edgecombe, who was held out of Friday's 125-120 loss to the Boston Celtics for precautionary reasons, Sixers coach Nick Nurse gave the closest glimpse of what his team may look like this season.

The other active Sixers starters -- LeBron James, Tyrese Maxey, Jaylen Brown and Embiid -- all played preseason highs in minutes and well into the second half. Embiid, who struggled in his last appearance two games ago against the Brooklyn Nets, finishing with six points and eight turnovers, was dominant.​

He scored 27 points, grabbed eight rebounds and added five assists. In the third quarter, he had one of the game's highlights when he threw down an emphatic dunk that drew roars from fans at Xfinity Mobile Arena.

"It's good to dunk. I thought I would never dunk again," Embiid said with a smile. "I guess I don't know what happened. I kind of got possessed."

Still, the group never looked comfortable together on the floor, despite playing against Celtics reserves. After the game, players didn't shy away from their somewhat disjointed performance. Brown pointed to the team's spacing Friday night, which he said led to turnovers, as one of the many things they need to fix moving forward.

"We're not where we want to be yet," he said. "So that's just a part of it. It's a part of coming together, a new group with a bunch of guys, different style, but we just got to keep getting better every day."

James echoed Brown's comments, but neither seemed concerned about the Sixers' ability to eventually jell.

"We're getting there," James said. "I mean, obviously we are a couple of weeks in, so we're still working on our rhythm, working on our kinks, and it's not going to be perfect."

The Sixers open the regular season against the New York Knicks on Tuesday.

articles.headline: No. 1 pick AJ Dybantsa injures ankle during Wizards' preseason finale
articles.description: First overall pick AJ Dybantsa exited the Wizards' preseason finale after injuring his ankle on an awkward landing and will undergo further evaluation.
articles.body:
First overall pick AJ Dybantsa exited the Washington Wizards' preseason finale Friday after injuring his ankle on an awkward landing and will undergo further evaluation.

Wizards coach Brian Keefe told sideline reporter Chase Hughes that Dybantsa had suffered a mild ankle sprain but that the decision to keep him out for the rest of the game was more precautionary.

"We'll look at it more when we get more information," Keefe said.

Dybantsa fell to the ground after landing on his left ankle following a midrange jump shot before limping to the locker room. He had scored 12 points in 15 minutes before his exit in the second quarter.

The Wizards open the regular season Wednesday against the Milwaukee Bucks.

articles.description: 'Being Ben' premieres on Sunday,
articles.headlineJa: ベン・シモンズの「E60」ドキュメンタリーの視聴方法
articles.descriptionJa: 「Being Ben」が日曜日に初放送されます。
articles.body:
Former No. 1 NBA draft pick Ben Simmons sheds light on his polarizing career in a new ESPN E60 documentary, 'Being Ben.' Now with the Sacramento Kings, the documentary explores the ups and downs of his time in the league and the lifelong passion he has for fishing.

Here's more information about the program.

When does it air?

'Being Ben' premieres on Sunday at 4 p.m. ET on ESPN.

How can fans watch?

Following its linear premiere, 'Being Ben' will stream afterward on the ESPN App. It can be watched on the documentary's streaming hub.
